chapter: Taped excerpts: friends, family and facts
title: His real name and not being a Chicago bandleader
summary: Johnson says his name was never Jimmy and that he was never a bandleader or professional pianist in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Okay. And I'd like to record, you know, a couple of the answers from you on some questions that I have. All right? All right, the first is I found this reference paper which indicated that your name is Jimmy. So I would like you to just tell me what your real name is and if it ever was Jimmy or not.
My real name is -- never was Jimmy.
And it wasn't then. And it isn't now.
My real name is J. C. Johnson.
Right, but it was not you. Good. Terrific. Okay, and the other thing is were you ever a band leader in Chicago?
All right. And did you ever play piano professionally in Chicago?
